title: Sharplink FAQ
description: A plain, square FAQ on the dotted three-column grid: a big title on the left whose letters assemble as you scroll, a label and tinted button at the top right, and the questions across the two right columns as faint 74px rows (4px apart) with a small numbered badge, 19px question and a solid black plus box. Rows deepen on hover; answers open with a slow 1.2s height ease.
notes: CSS only: native details elements; the height ease uses ::details-content and interpolate-size where supported (elsewhere answers open instantly)
transparent background: on the page it shows the Sharplink backdrop wash
name: sharplink-faq
